author: Daniel Howleytechnology Editor
title: Apple Q2 2018 earnings
text: Tim Cook presents the iPhone X. (Getty Images) More Apple (AAPL) announced its Q2 2018 financial results on Tuesday. Apple sold 52.2 million iPhones during the quarter, which was just about in line with analysts’ estimates, which called for the company to sell 52.3 million iPhones. The tech giant posted earnings of $2.73 per share on $61.1 billion of revenue. Those numbers beat analyst expectations of $2.64 earnings per share on $60.9 billion of revenue. This is likely a relief to investors who were concerned about soft sales of the iPhone X due to its high price, and warnings from component manufacturers. Apple is increasing their cash return program by $100 billion. Apple’s stock is up 4% on the news in after hours trading. Developing…
